en.headline: Woman dies after fall at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a 26-year-old woman was found unconscious in a light well at Chelsea Heights on Saturday morning and later died in hospital.
body: A 26-year-old woman has died after falling at Chelsea Heights in Tuen Mun on Saturday morning, police said.

Officers were called at about 8am after security staff at 1 Shek Pai Tau Path reported a woman lying in a light well. Police said she was unconscious when found and was taken by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital, where she died.

Preliminary inquiries suggested she had fallen from a flat in the block. Police said no note was found at the scene. The case is being treated as a fall from height, and the cause of death will be determined after an autopsy.

zh.headline: 屯門卓爾居女子墮樓不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六早上屯門石排頭徑卓爾居一名26歲女子倒臥天井，送院後不治，案件列作從高處墮下。
body: 屯門卓爾居周六早上發生有人從高處墮下事件，一名26歲女子送院後不治。
警方稱，約上午8時接獲石排頭徑1號保安報案，指一名女子倒臥天井，懷疑從高處墮下。警員到場時她已昏迷，由救護車送往屯門醫院，其後不治。
初步調查相信她由大廈一個單位墮下。警方表示現場沒有發現遺書，案件列作有人從高處墮下處理，死因有待驗屍確定。
